name: Dirección y capas de VFX, audio y ambiente para Ohmdal Arco I

physicalAnchors.assemblyRole: event-driven procedural VFX, WebAudio soundscape and zone ambient lighting
physicalAnchors.scaleSource: accepted greybox and authored zone models

mustPreserve: energy is an event, not wallpaper: copper, stone and machines do not glow passively
event-driven VFX layers: conductorPulse, terminalArcBurst, contactSnap, heatRamp, waterMist, dustWake, generatorSpinUp, protectionTrip
procedural WebAudio soundscapes: 50Hz hum, bell overtones, hydraulic flow, turbine spin-up, breaker clunks, forge thermal roar, lake breeze and calibration feedback
zone-specific ambient lighting reflecting night arrival, sealed castle violet shadows, industrial forge contrast, terraced sunset sheen, and dark lake lighthouse
quiet/off state when circuits or hydraulic valves are open or inactive
deterministic parameter tuning with explicit mobile scaling and reduced-motion compliance
no generic victory shimmer or unmotivated neon saturation on return
mayResolve: exact mist quad particle count and lifetime curves
conductor pulse travel speeds along complex curved bus lines
micro-arc flash decay curves and spark scatter radius
WebAudio filter cutoff frequencies and gain envelope timings
forbidden: permanent copper glow or full-scene neon emissive wallpaper
unmotivated persistent particle storms or fireworks
invented RC pulse timing or non-ratified electrical mechanics
fantasy spell sparkles detached from physical conductors or switches
unmuted autoplay audio without user interaction handling
degradation of mobile performance budgets or GPU fill rate
inventing new narrative dialogue or changing verified network topology
approvalNote: Approved for the A7 VFX, Audio and Ambient authored pass. Defines the canonical rules for event-driven effects, procedural audio, and zone-specific lighting.

referenceAudit.primaryRationale: OHMDAL_VFX_AUDIO_PLAN.md and direccion-ambiental-arco1.md establish the physical rules of event-driven electricity, water motion, and lighting across all Arco I zones.
